_corpusRoot: Where documents are read from, relative to the folder run.bat sits in.
'..'  the engine is a folder inside your project - the default
'.'   run.bat and scripts were pasted into the project root itself
An absolute path also works. rag\ is always created beside run.bat, never here,
so renaming or moving the engine folder never scatters its state.
The engine folder is excluded from its own index automatically, whatever you
have named it - nothing anywhere hardcodes a folder name.
_doNotTranslate: Terms the translator must not turn into the target language.
strict      hidden from the model completely, like a code span, so it comes
back byte-identical. Use for names that must never inflect:
a product, a company, a file format, an acronym.
declinable  sent to the model and checked with a relaxed gate that allows
a case ending, because the term has become an ordinary noun in
ONLY generic technical vocabulary belongs in this file - it ships with the
engine and is the same for every project. Put your own product and company
names in rag\rag.config.json, where they are ADDED to this list rather than
replacing it, so you never have to restate '.NET' to add your own name.
Beware of short common words: entries match case-insensitively on a word
boundary, so adding 'Go' also protects every ordinary 'go' in the document.
